tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with normal red cell indices, mild leukopenia, and normal platelet count but significantly increased platelet distribution width, suggesting anisocytosis. Findings are consistent with normocytic, normochromic anemia, possibly due to chronic disease or bone marrow dysfunction. Further clinical correlation and additional investigations are recommended.
